Equans

Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
MP / P4 170000481

Problem Description:
Charger is Unavailable.
We found an error flag in the SCB that the 12 V DC power supply is interrupted from TB18. A site visit is needed to troubleshoot the issue.
Upon reviewing our asset database, we found that the product is no longer under warranty since 04/08/2024, as a result, we are transferring the case to the regional queue.
Kindly communicate with the customer and provide the necessary service support and/or offer. We have already informed the customer that a regional representative will be in touch shortly.
